limits: Touch was emulated (Chromium hasTouch at 390x844); no real phone, no Brave, and no screen reader were used. Accessible names were read from Chromium's accessibility tree through Playwright's aria snapshot.
Firebase was blocked, so the app ran on its local adapter with the offline banner; online play and the live leaderboard were not exercised (this PR has no data-layer change).
Performance was not measured in this run (separate /benchmark).

Checkpoint 004's observationCommand names probe 002's command by mistake; its observed text is probe 003's output, which is the right one. Published checkpoints are never edited, so it stays as written.

The ISSUE-001 regression check was added to themes-test.mjs after the repair. Its red evidence is the same exact-name lookup failing on the old build in probes 004, 005 and 006, not a red run of the new check itself.
The repo has no UI test framework; the browser checks are throwaway scripts kept outside the repo (coverage debt, as recorded in CLAUDE.md).
The three bad-settings checks in probe 007 failed on a test error (a colour read before the stylesheet applied); the test was corrected narrowly and probe 008 reran the same command.
